explanation: The request asks for eta electroproduction (ep -> e'p eta) radiative corrections at W = 1.2 GeV. This is kinematically forbidden: the eta-channel EXCLURAD source (eta/exclurad.F, eta/spp.inc) uses m_p = 0.938272 GeV and m_eta = 0.54786 GeV, giving a hadronic threshold of W_min = m_p + m_eta = 1.486132 GeV. This is corroborated by the EtaMAID-2023 hadronic model grid in eta/mpintp.inc, whose W axis (NVAR2) explicitly starts at 1.4856 GeV and runs to 6 GeV -- there is no tabulated or physical cross section below that point. At W = 1.2 GeV the Born cross section for p+eta production is exactly zero (insufficient invariant mass to produce a proton plus an eta meson), so no meaningful radiative correction can be computed; attempting to run the code at this point would either fail in the interpolation routine or return a spurious/undefined result. No input file was generated. If a nearby physical point is desired, W >= ~1.487 GeV (e.g. W = 1.50 GeV) at the same Q2 = 1.0 GeV^2, cos(theta*) = 0, phi* = 90 deg would be a valid substitute and can be generated on request.
